visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a small earring is seated behind a professional white Shure SM7B style microphone mounted on a white desk stand. He is wearing a white T-shirt with a small graphic logo on the chest. The background shows a window with green foliage and a glimpse of a modern indoor room with neutral lighting. He gestures with his right hand, pointing upward while speaking directly to the camera in a medium-close shot. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up interior of a car, specifically focusing on the driver's side door panel. A man's hand with a gold ring points at the electronic window controls and then indicates a manual mechanical release handle located just ahead of them. The interior features dark plastics and gray fabric textures. Red arrows and circular highlights are superimposed on the video to draw attention to the specific car parts being demonstrated. (3) The camera moves to the rear passenger footwell of the vehicle. A hand reaches into a small storage pocket and lifts a plastic cover marked with a triangular warning symbol. This action reveals a recessed compartment containing a bright yellow emergency pull-loop. The lighting inside the car is natural but slightly shadowed compared to the studio shots. The background consists of the black car carpet and the edge of a leather seat. (4) A static promotional graphic is displayed on a clean white background. It features two black fabric pull-straps labeled with the brand name 'JOWUA' in white text. Surrounding the main product are smaller inset photographs showing the product packaging and its installation inside a car. Large black text overlays provide pricing details and model compatibility information, serving as an informative product showcase segment. (5) The video returns to the car interior to demonstrate the product installation. A hand is seen attaching a metal ring from the black strap to the car's yellow emergency loop. The strap is then folded and secured using its velcro surface against the car's interior carpet, creating a neat and accessible handle. Later, a hand interacts with a large Tesla infotainment screen, navigating through a menu written in Chinese to show the 'Child Safety' settings. (6) The final phase shows the man back in his studio environment, addressing the camera directly. He uses expansive hand gestures as he gives a safety warning. The video concludes with a full-screen graphic on a black background featuring a large white and black QR code. The brand logo for the discussion group and text inviting viewers to join a LINE community are prominently displayed as the final visual call to action.
